summary: Three focused features shipped this session under the operator's 'continue on while I get the Netlify site ready ... don't trust verify execute like a professional' directive. Phase 2.6a — witness co-signing via manual envelope-JSON exchange: new cosigning feature folder with parseEnvelope (assertWellFormed-validated paste), mergeSignatures (envelopeId-match + dedupe + verifyEnvelope sanity), EnvelopePreview (plain-English render), and three modals (request / sign-as-witness / absorb). Phase 2.6b — custody handoff: createCustodyHandoff builds a meta-kind attestation with action='custody_handoff', signed by the current custodian; the witness flow handles the new custodian's signature; absorb merges. JournalDetail surfaces 'Hand off custody of {subject}' only when subject != wallet.identity. Phase 2.7 — generic attachments: renamed claim leaves photo_* → attachment_*, composer has two upload buttons (📷 Photo with capture=environment for the grandchild scenario, 📄 Document with broad MIME accept), Card/Detail/downloadEntry/EnvelopePreview all updated to handle image vs document rendering. Three commits landed (88a7c89, a036a27, 9e7ab4b) plus the prior verify-pass commits (528dc81, 78baa01, a33474e). Branch and main both at 9e7ab4b.
